name: Community First Bancorporation
summary: Community First Bancorporation functions as the parent entity for Community First Bank, providing an array of commercial banking products and services tailored for both individual and corporate clients across Walhalla, Seneca, Anderson, Williamston, Westminster, and Greenville, South Carolina, as well as North Carolina. The company was established in 1988 and its main office is situated in Walhalla, South Carolina.
